{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm the cleaning worked by checking a few values
print('Sample cleaned revenue:', df['revenue_clean'].head())

# Now, check the conversion rate by customer_segment
# Conversion rate = (number of converted orders) / (total orders) per segment
conversion_rate = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
conversion_rate['conversion_rate'] = conversion_rate['sum'] / conversion_rate['count']

# Sort by conversion rate descending
conversion_rate_sorted = conversion_rate.sort_values('conversion_rate', ascending=False)
print('\nConversion rates by customer_segment:\n', conversion_rate_sorted)

# Get the segment with highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rate_sorted.index[0]
print(f'\nHighest conversion rate segment: {highest_segment}')"}
